turns: How do I set up a Python virtual environment on Windows?
Run python -m venv .venv, then activate it with .\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1 in PowerShell.
Activation fails with 'running scripts is disabled'. What now?
Run Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope CurrentUser RemoteSigned once, then activate again.
Now how do I install my package in editable mode?
Add a pyproject.toml, then run pip install -e . from the project root.
